java.say: Someone needs a free square. Only the board has the list of squares, so the board is the expert.
It looks through its own squares, one by one.
It asks each square whether it is empty, and returns the first empty one. The square is the expert for that question.
When no square is free, it returns null: nothing.

cpp.say: Someone needs a free square. Only the board has the list of squares, so the board is the expert.
It looks through its own squares, one by one.
It asks each square whether it is empty, and returns the address of the first empty one. The square is the expert for that question.
When no square is free, it returns nullptr: nothing.
